title: Among female patients with normal Rhuematoid Factor and no recorded symptom
question: Among female patients with normal Rhuematoid Factor and no recorded symptoms, find the one with the highest uric acid level within the normal range, and return her anti-Cardiolipin antibody concentrations along with her age.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T3."XCL_041", T3."XCL_016"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T1."XCL_063" = '-'
  AND T2."XCL_012" IS NULL
  AND T3."XCL_022" <= 6.5
ORDER BY T3."XCL_022" DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_005", (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060")) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_001"
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T2."XCL_009" = '-'
  AND T2."XCL_006" IS NULL
  AND T3."XCL_027" < 7
ORDER BY T3."XCL_027" DESC
LIMIT 1;
